```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

data = pd.read_csv("/Users/mateoflores/Documents/Tec/ProjectMultivariados/data/electrophoresis.csv")
data.head()
```

```{python}
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

pca = PCA(n_components = None, svd_solver = "full")
```

```{python}
pca_fit = pca.fit(data)
```

```{python}
import numpy as np
np.sqrt(pca_fit.explained_variance_)
```

```{python}
prop_variance = pca_fit.explained_variance_ratio_
prop_variance
```

```{python}
cumulative_prop = prop_variance.cumsum()
```

```{python}
loadings = pca_fit.components_
```

```{python}
scores = pca_fit.fit_transform(data)
```

```{python}
df = pd.DataFrame({"PC1": scores[:, 0],
                   "PC2": scores[:, 1]})
```

```{python}
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x = 'PC1',
    y = 'PC2',
)

plt.show()
```


```{python}
x_bar = data.mean().values
```

```{python}
S = np.cov(data, rowvar=False)
```

```{python}
Lambda, Gamma = np.linalg.eig(S)
```

```{python}
idx = Lambda.argsort()[::-1]
Lambda = Lambda[idx]
Lambda = Lambda.real
Gamma = Gamma[:, idx]
Gamma = Gamma.real
```

```{python}
print(f"Usando la descomposición espectral: {Lambda}")
print(f"Usando scikit-learn: {pca_fit.explained_variance_}")
```

```{python}
pd.DataFrame(Gamma)
```

```{python}
pd.DataFrame(pca_fit.components_.T)
```

```{python}
(Lambda/Lambda.sum()).cumsum()
```

```{python}
q = 2
E = Gamma[:, :q]
```

```{python}
Z = (data - x_bar) @ E
```

```{python}
Z = Z.rename({0: "PC1", 1: "PC2"}, axis=1)
```

```{python}
sns.scatterplot(Z,
                x = "PC1",
                y = "PC2",
                color = "dodgerblue")
plt.xlabel("PC1")
plt.ylabel("PC2")
plt.title("Scores")
plt.show();
```

```{python}
x_hat = Z @ E.T + x_bar
```

```{python}
x_hat.columns = data.columns
```

```{python}
(len(data) - 1) * Lambda[q:].sum()
```
